title: Phir hai ab shaam ka safar bhai
body:
Phir hai ab shaam ka safar bhai
Tum chalo saath ho kidhar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ke safar ki Yaad aayi
Ro rahi hoon main nouhagar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Bhai Bahen ye jaati hai
Chordthi hoon main aaj ghar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Abid (as) ko leke jaati hoon
Hua khaali tamaam ghar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum bhi bolo bahen khuda hafiz
Phir main hoti hoon darbadar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Na to Abbas(as) hai na Akbar(as) hai
Aap bhi chal diye kidhar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise Zainab (sa) sawaar ho bolo
Jhuk gayi hai meri kamar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Rahem Khao meri zayeefi par
Hogaya hai safaid sar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Main hoon Abid (as) hai aur Fizza(sa) hai
Khafila hai ye muqtasar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahtemaam e safar nahi karte
Hai mera aaqri safar bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Ali Bekasi wo Zainab(sa) ki
Roke Kehna gaye kidhar bhai
